cards.card_text: Here, Paul says, there's no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave or free.
cards.verse_text: Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free, but Christ is all and is in all.
